headline: Gold and silver prices rise again in Bangladesh after a significant drop
summary: After a recent fall, the prices of gold and silver have increased in the Bangladeshi market as of July 10, 2026, impacting buyers and sellers.
details: Gold and silver prices have seen an increase in the Bangladeshi market, effective July 10, 2026.
This rise follows a period of significant decline in the prices of both precious metals, reversing a recent trend.
The adjustment in prices is expected to influence consumer purchasing decisions and the local jewelry market across the country.

headline_marked: Cox's Bazar [[prepares 648 shelters]] as continuous rain causes disruption; control room opened
headline: Cox's Bazar prepares 648 shelters as continuous rain causes disruption; control room opened
summary: Continuous heavy rainfall has severely affected Cox's Bazar, prompting local authorities to open a control room and prepare numerous shelters to assist residents.
details: Heavy rainfall has severely disrupted life in Cox's Bazar, leading to widespread waterlogging and potential displacement. Local authorities are taking proactive measures to ensure public safety.

A total of 648 shelters have been prepared across the district to accommodate residents who may need to evacuate their homes. These shelters are equipped to provide temporary refuge and essential services.

A dedicated control room has also been established to monitor the situation continuously and coordinate relief efforts. This central hub will manage emergency responses and disseminate crucial information to the public.
